standard_prerequisites.name: Lifting lemma with annihilator hypotheses
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces D -> Lambda with the smoothness of R -> D at primes off pi and over the smooth locus of the mod-pi^8 resolution.

standard_prerequisites.name: Desingularization with compatible mod-pi^4 maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces B with A -> B -> Lambda and D -> B -> Lambda and the inclusion H_{D/R}B inside H_{B/R}.

core_obligations: Apply the lifting lemma: get R -> D -> Lambda with a mod-pi^4 factorization through the given resolution, D smooth at primes not containing pi and at primes over the smooth locus of R/pi^8R -> bar-C.
Apply the desingularize-strictly-standard lemma with the induced compatibility map A/pi^4A -> D/pi^4D: get B finitely presented with A -> B -> Lambda and D -> B -> Lambda and H_{D/R}B inside H_{B/R}.

Assemble the two outputs into the stated conclusion: R_pi -> B_pi is smooth because D is smooth at the primes of B_pi (all off pi or over the smooth locus), and the radical inclusion H_{bar-C/(R/pi^8R)} Lambda/pi^8Lambda inside the radical of H_{B/R}Lambda mod pi^8Lambda follows by chasing singular ideals along the smooth loci recorded in step 1, in the manner demonstrated inside the desingularize-strictly-standard proof.
proof_roadmap: Lifting application; desingularization application; conclusion assembly chase.
difficulty_reason: A two-lemma application whose remaining work is the assembly chase of the conclusions; the chase template is demonstrated in the same-batch carded proof of desingularize-strictly-standard.
